title: 第11章 不许自己瞎练第12章 一般人兜不住的弟子
content_zh:
;;
拜师典礼没那么隆重，苏白尘只是被带着在祖师画像前磕了磕头，然后又在玄阴真人面前磕完头，就算是正式入门了。
苏白尘并不因为这拜师的潦草而感到不满，甚至还觉得这是玄阴真人对他的爱护。
毕竟这阴宗弟子本来就看他这个‘空降真传’不顺眼了吧？低调一些，对他来说就是一种保护。
“这本《玄阴气诀》你且拿去好生翻看，若有不懂之处也切忌自己尝试，等我明日为你详细讲解。”
“现在，让你师兄带你去住处安顿吧。”
苏白尘被警告了一下。
他不敢有什么多余的话，只是应着告辞。
出来，枫林子就对他说：“来，我带你去袇房，别担心，就在我的袇房边上。”
（袇【rán】房，道士居住修炼的地方。）
苏白尘欢喜地应了，而后随着枫林子走入了一处邻水的廊桥。
这长春阴宗的驻地就建在阴风关山崖下方！
这一路紧贴着山崖挖开峭壁形成了一座悬空道宫！
而这道宫有一半是在阴风峡外，平日里有阳光照射。
但是弟子们的袇房却都一路延伸到了海峡内。
这里终年无日光照射，阴冷潮湿且直面那阴风峡内深邃而见不到尽头的狭长海峡。
当苏白尘看到那半边嵌在崖壁中半边则是悬空在外，推开窗户就是黑漆漆的阴风峡时，心情颇为微妙。
“这里比较潮湿，不过袇房内有炭炉，你将之点燃了就好。”
“平日里会有外门弟子给你送来柴火，不必担心。”
说着他从怀里摸出一张黄纸来，对着苏白尘房间里的那个炭炉就丢了过去。

这符纸在空中就化作一颗火球，一下将那炭炉给点燃了。
确定这房间内排风透气做得不错，苏白尘也就放下心来。
而且这房间内点燃了炭炉之后也明显明亮了许多，苏白尘心里头也舒服了一些。
“行了，需要什么日常用品都可以去外事处那边问问，其他有什么问题都可以来找我，我就在你隔壁。”
说着拍了拍苏白尘的肩膀便告辞离去了。
苏白尘送别了枫林子，这才大大松了一口气。
他先是在床上躺了下来，可是那潮湿的被褥令他不是很适应，只能等炭炉将之烤干燥了再说。
随后他来到窗口，脚下木质地板踩上去‘嘎吱嘎吱’的，甚至能够从缝隙中看到下方涌动的漆黑如墨的海水以及翻起的白色浪花。
门窗并排，而窗口外就是海峡另一侧的峭壁，几乎近在眼前的感觉，视觉上很压抑。
门窗外头是他们过来的廊桥，站在廊桥上正对着前进的方向，就好像这是条直通向深渊的道路一样。
这种居住环境，可以说是险恶。
但苏白尘想到自己先前利用阴气修炼时的情形，立刻就明白将袇房建在这种环境中，的确是最适合阴宗弟子修炼的。
而想到这个，他连忙来到炭炉旁，借着碳炉的火光翻开那《玄阴气诀》……
【玄阴之初，自幽而生。
寂然不动，万念归冥。
敛神入窍，气沉丹田。
寒凝骨脉，霜镇心田。
吸天地幽，纳九地阴……】
好家伙，苏白尘只是看着这段总纲的口诀，心里头就有许多疑问迎刃而解！
他正不明白那引来的阴气该容纳在何处，若是同样纳入丹田，那岂不是要和真气冲突了？

The apprenticeship ceremony was not that grand. Su Baichen was just led to kowtow in front of the portrait of his ancestor, and then finished kowtowing in front of Master Xuanyin, which was considered a formal entry.
Su Baichen was not dissatisfied with the sloppy apprenticeship, and even felt that it was Master Xuanyin's love for him.
After all, this Yin Sect disciple originally disliked his ‘airborne true inheritance’, right? Being low-key is a kind of protection for him.
"Please take this book of "Xuan Yin Qi Jue" and read it through. If you don't understand anything, don't try it yourself. I will explain it to you in detail tomorrow."
"Now, let your senior brother take you to your residence to settle down."
Su Baichen was warned.
He didn't dare to say anything unnecessary and just said goodbye.
When he came out, Feng Linzi said to him: "Come, I will take you to the closet. Don't worry, it's right next to my closet."
(袇[rán] Fang, the place where Taoist priests live and practice.)
Su Baichen happily agreed, and then followed Feng Linzi into a covered bridge next to the water.
The Changchun Yin Sect's headquarters is built under the cliff of Yinfengguan!
This road dug out the cliff close to the cliff to form a suspended Taoist palace!
Half of this palace is outside Yinfeng Gorge, where the sun shines on weekdays.
But the disciples' dormitories all extend all the way into the strait.
There is no sunlight all year round here, it is cold and humid, and it faces the deep and endless narrow strait in the Yinfeng Gorge.
When Su Baichen saw that half of it was embedded in the cliff and the other half was suspended in the air, and when he opened the window and saw the dark Yinfeng Gorge, he felt quite subtle.
"It's relatively humid here, but there's a charcoal stove in the dormitory. Just light it up."
"On weekdays, outer disciples will bring you firewood, so don't worry."
As he spoke, he took out a piece of yellow paper from his arms and threw it towards the charcoal stove in Su Baichen's room.
The talisman turned into a fireball in the air and ignited the charcoal stove.
After confirming that the ventilation and ventilation in this room were good, Su Baichen felt relieved.
Moreover, the room became much brighter after lighting the charcoal stove, and Su Baichen felt a little more comfortable.
"Okay, if you need any daily necessities, you can go to the Foreign Affairs Office and ask. If you have any other questions, you can come to me. I'm right next door to you."
Then he patted Su Baichen on the shoulder and left.
Su Baichen said goodbye to Feng Linzi and breathed a sigh of relief.
He lay down on the bed first, but the damp bedding made him uncomfortable, so he could only wait for the charcoal stove to dry it.
Then he came to the window. The wooden floor creaked under his feet, and he could even see the dark water and the white waves surging below through the gaps.
The doors and windows are side by side, and outside the window is the cliff on the other side of the strait. It feels like it is almost in front of you, which is visually very depressing.
Outside the door and window is the covered bridge they came from. Standing on the covered bridge facing the direction of travel, it is as if it is a road leading straight to the abyss.
This kind of living environment can be said to be dangerous.
But Su Baichen thought of the situation when he used Yin Qi to practice before, and immediately understood that building a dormitory in this environment was indeed the most suitable for Yin Sect disciples to practice.
Thinking of this, he quickly came to the charcoal stove and opened the "Xuan Yin Qi Jue" by the light of the charcoal stove...
[At the beginning of Xuanyin, it was born from the darkness.
Silent and motionless, all thoughts return to the dead.
Gather the spirit into the orifice, and sink the energy in the Dantian.
Cold condenses the veins of the bones, frost calms the heart.
Absorb the darkness of heaven and earth, absorb the yin of nine earths...]
Good guy, Su Baichen just looked at this general outline, and many questions in his mind were solved!
He just didn't understand where to store the Yin Qi he had attracted. If it were also included in his Dantian, wouldn't it conflict with the True Qi?
